goals.text: Set a post to Only me and confirm it is not public.

giveUp: Gave up. The screen did not change after 3 actions.
deadEnds: the screen did not change after 3 actions
device: GRIIT iPhone 16. Persona phone size was recorded and not applied, because this is the simulator that has the app installed.

interview.openTomorrow: Yes, I'd open it tomorrow. It's just for me, so there's no pressure. I can check in privately and keep track of my routine without anyone knowing.
interview.secured: I think it means my data and activity are protected and private. Like, only I can see what I'm doing in the app.
interview.freeze: It's like a safety net. If I miss a day, I can use a freeze to buy myself time instead of losing my streak completely. You get one every week or something.
interview.selfReported: That means I'm telling the app myself about what I did, like checking in to confirm I completed something. It's all on my honor.
interview.best: Probably setting it to 'Only me' for visibility. That felt really good. I didn't have to worry about anyone seeing my progress or judging me.
interview.worst: Having to choose between 'Standard' and 'Strict' mode. Both felt like they were pushing me hard, and I don't like that kind of pressure. I just want something simple.
interview.tellFriend: No, I wouldn't tell a friend about this. It's private for me. If they asked, I might say I'm using an app to build better habits, but I wouldn't go into details or recommend it. It just feels too personal.
